description: This Java class 'CreditAllocationsValidator' provides validation logic for credit allocation rules within a loan product context in the Fineract project. It includes methods to validate rules based on payment strategies, check for duplicates, and ensure correct ordering of credit allocations.

classes.name: CreditAllocationsValidator
classes.description: A service class responsible for validating credit allocation rules in loan products, ensuring compliance with specific payment strategies and rule configurations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a list of credit allocation rules against a specified payment strategy code, checking for duplicates and rule correctness.

methods.name: validatePairOfOrderAndCreditAllocationType
methods.description: Validates that a list of pairs representing credit allocation order and type contains exactly four entries, with no duplicates and correct order.

methods.name: hasDuplicateTransactionTypes
methods.description: Checks if the list of rules contains duplicate transaction types.

methods.name: validateAllocationRule
methods.description: Validates individual credit allocation rule for valid transaction type.

methods.name: isAdvancedPaymentStrategy
methods.description: Determines if the given code matches the advanced payment allocation strategy.

methods.name: hasLoanProductCreditAllocationRule
methods.description: Checks if the list of rules is non-empty.

methods.name: raiseValidationError
methods.description: Throws a validation exception with a specific error message.
